fusions.name: Plate Snag
fusions.desc: Hooks a steel-ringed mesh into the target's guard and wrenches, dealing 8 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Pauldron Swing
fusions.desc: Swings a mesh of steel rings through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and throwing it back 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance per hit to leave it [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ring-Mail Drape
fusions.desc: Drapes a conjured mesh of steel rings over you that absorbs the next 22 damage for 8 seconds and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Hauberk of Knots
fusions.desc: Conjures a hauberk of knotted steel mesh: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 8% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
